source_name: National Bank of Ukraine — bank managers register page (/bank_managers/)
why_relevant: Appears to be a structured NBU listing of approved bank managers — if it is a maintained register it gives a diffable snapshot of who currently holds board and management-board seats at each state bank, which is exactly the ground truth an appointments tracker needs.

source_name: PrivatBank press centre / news archive
why_relevant: First-party announcements of supervisory-board decisions on management-board appointments — e.g. the appointment of Nataliia Savchuk as Deputy Chair for operations after an open competitive selection (Dec 2024), and the Björkert CEO selection. Also the place where org-structure and new-function announcements land.

source_name: Ukreximbank press centre (Новини банку / News, uk + en)
why_relevant: Publishes management-board appointments (e.g. Hanna Parkhomenko appointed Management Board member responsible for finance), the start of work of a renewed supervisory board with full name lists and elected chair/deputy, government appointment confirmations, and supervisory-board statements during conflicts. Maintains a parallel English site, which is unusual and useful for cross-language coverage.

source_name: Ukrgasbank press centre (УКРГАЗБАНК, прес-центр / новини)
why_relevant: First-party record of management-board changes (e.g. NBU approval of Andrii Kravets as Chairman of the Board) and, importantly, the bank publishes its organisational structure as a dated PDF — a rare direct artefact for the 'organization changes' topic.

source_name: Oschadbank corporate site — news and corporate governance section
why_relevant: Home of the bank's own announcements on supervisory-board and management-board appointments and on the CEO competitive selection launched in August 2025 with international recruiters. URL pattern inferred from the bank's domain rather than confirmed by a fetched listing page, hence lower confidence.

source_name: NSSMC issuer-disclosure systems: stockmarket.gov.ua and SMIDA
why_relevant: State banks are securities issuers (bonds/shares) and must file 'Особлива інформація емітента — відомості про зміну складу посадових осіб емітента' within statutory deadlines. This is the most machine-readable, legally dated record of every officer appointment/dismissal, including the reason and the person's prior positions — better structured than press releases. SMIDA holds the per-issuer profile (Oschadbank EDRPOU 00032129).

source_name: Kyiv Independent — Ukraine State-Owned Enterprises Weekly
why_relevant: An independent weekly digest specifically covering SOEs and state-owned banks, running to 150+ issues. It systematically records supervisory-board nominations, who nominated whom (Cabinet / President / Rada committee), NBU approvals and governance-reform milestones, with links back to primary sources — the single best English-language snowballing index for this cell and an excellent backfill for historical timelines.

source_name: Minfin.com.ua — bank news portal and per-company news feeds
source_subtype: financial news portal with company tag feeds
why_relevant: High-frequency financial news portal (not the ministry) with per-bank tag feeds. Consistently the first aggregator to carry appointment stories — Oschadbank management-board appointments, Cabinet appointing new Oschadbank supervisory board, the Aug-2025 launch of the Oschadbank CEO competition with international recruiters, and the Oct-2025 fintech specialist joining the board. Useful as a fast tripwire that then points to the primary record.

source_name: Ukrinform — state news agency, economy section
why_relevant: State news agency that reliably reports Cabinet appointment decisions on state-bank supervisory boards the day they are taken ('Уряд призначив новий склад наглядової ради Ощадбанку', 'Уряд призначив нових членів наглядової ради ПриватБанку', 'ПриватБанк обрав нового голову правління'). Bilingual (uk/en) and stable URLs.

source_name: Forbes.ua — banking/finance news
why_relevant: Covers state-bank leadership changes with useful biographical context on the appointee (e.g. Ukrgasbank electing Polish banker Piotr Kaczmarek as board chair; Cabinet appointing PrivatBank independent board members). Good for the 'who is this person and what does the appointment signal' layer.

source_name: Ekonomichna Pravda (epravda.com.ua) — SOE governance analysis
why_relevant: Runs analytical pieces on state-bank governance and CEO searches (e.g. '"Укрексімбанк" шукає нового голову правління'), often flagging a search before formal announcement and explaining the political economy behind it — an early-warning and interpretation source rather than a record-of-fact source.

source_name: Mind.ua — banking sector news
why_relevant: Reports both the bank-side decision and the regulator-side confirmation, including the distinctive 'Нацбанк призначив голів правління Укргазбанку й ОТП Банку' framing that captures the NBU approval step, and the PrivatBank CEO announcement. Useful for reconstructing the two-step appointment/approval chain.

source_name: RBC-Ukraine — finance section
why_relevant: Reported Sense Bank adding a new independent supervisory-board member and profiled the PrivatBank CEO choice. Sense Bank is the least well covered of the five by official feeds (it is nationalised and its board is appointed via the DGF/MoF route), so media coverage carries disproportionate weight for that actor.

source_name: Kurs.com.ua — banking news aggregator (ru/uk)
why_relevant: Carried the Sense Bank governance crisis of 2026 — Cabinet suspending supervisory-board chair Mykola Hladyshenko and initiating removal of board chair Oleksii Stupak, and the board's appearance in the 'Mindich tapes'. Captures the contested/scandal-driven half of leadership change that official feeds understate.

source_name: UNIAN / Glavcom — governance-conflict reporting on state banks
why_relevant: Covered the NBU demanding dismissal of the Sense Bank supervisory-board chair and the Cabinet terminating his powers — the regulator-versus-shareholder friction that precedes forced board turnover. Two separate outlets reporting the same event give a corroboration pair.

source_name: Yurydychna Gazeta (yur-gazeta.com) — legal-professional coverage of Cabinet governance acts
why_relevant: Legal trade press that reports Cabinet appointment orders on state-bank supervisory boards with the act reference and legal framing, which helps locate the underlying розпорядження on zakon.rada.gov.ua when the Cabinet news item is thin.

source_name: pb.bank.gov.ua — NBU microsite on PrivatBank under state protection
why_relevant: A dedicated NBU-hosted microsite about state-owned PrivatBank; likely to carry official governance and nationalisation-related documentation. Content not inspected, so its current usefulness for appointment tracking is a hypothesis.

source_name: Mastercard EEMEA Newsroom — Press Releases (Ukraine)
why_relevant: Mastercard announces Ukraine/Moldova country-manager activity, MoUs and market leadership from the EEMEA regional newsroom rather than any Ukrainian-language channel. Primary announcement venue for scheme-level Ukraine leadership signals.

source_name: Mastercard Newsroom — Our Executives / Leadership Bios (EEMEA)
why_relevant: Canonical roster of Mastercard EEMEA executives including the Ukraine & Moldova country manager (Inga Andreieva bio page). Diffing this roster over time detects country-manager changes before any press release.

source_name: Visa Ukraine Newsroom / Press Releases (visa.com.ua, uk_UA)
why_relevant: Visa publishes Ukraine regional-manager appointments here in Ukrainian — e.g. the Tetyana Chorna appointment as VP/Regional Manager Ukraine. This is the scheme's own local-language announcement channel and the highest-fidelity source for Visa Ukraine leadership.

source_name: Visa CEMEA Newsroom (regional press releases)
why_relevant: Regional-president and CEMEA cluster-lead appointments that determine who Ukraine's country lead reports to (e.g. Tareq Muhmood as CEMEA Regional President; Kristina Dorosh as SVP covering 17 countries incl. Ukraine) are announced regionally, never in Ukrainian press first.

source_name: National Bank of Ukraine — Information on Bank Managers register
why_relevant: Regulatory register of approved bank managers. Every foreign-parent appointment to a Ukrainian bank board (Raiffeisen, OTP, Ukrsibbank/BNP, Credit Agricole, ProCredit) must pass NBU fit-and-proper approval and lands here — the authoritative confirmation layer for parent-group appointments.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Aval Ukraine — Board / Management pages (raiffeisen.ua)
why_relevant: Live roster of the RBI-controlled Ukrainian subsidiary's management and supervisory boards (Pysaruk→Hurina CEO transition, deputy-chair changes). RBI parent nominates supervisory board members; this page reflects the outcome.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International AG — Media Hub press releases
why_relevant: Parent-group announcements of management-board and group-function appointments (CEO succession Strobl→Höllerer, CFO, Group Retail Banking, Group Risk Controlling) that cascade into the Ukrainian subsidiary's reporting lines and network strategy.

source_name: EQS News — RBI ad-hoc / regulatory announcements
why_relevant: Austrian listed-issuer ad-hoc disclosures (management-board appointments are ad-hoc reportable) arrive here in a structured, timestamped feed — often earlier and more parseable than the corporate site.

source_name: OTP Bank Ukraine — News & Shareholder/Stakeholder information
why_relevant: OTP Group's Ukrainian subsidiary publishes board appointments/dismissals and a dated organisational-structure PDF — the organisational chart is a rare, directly comparable artefact for detecting org changes, not just top-name changes.

source_name: EBRD Newsroom — News and events
why_relevant: EBRD announces its Managing Director for Ukraine and Moldova and country-head changes here; also announces governance interventions where EBRD sits on nomination committees for Ukrainian institutions.
